falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash close is at least 6% above or at least 6% below its close on the day of this verdict, on any session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A move of that size would show the UNKNOWN/HOLD call missed a resolved directional regime rather than a genuine non-call

falsification_conditions.condition: Rolling pattern similarity to bottom_2022_may_luna prints below 50% on the engine's own match score before day 14
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% Luna-bottom analog would be invalidated, so the phase label tied to that match cannot stand

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or VIX closes above 35 on two consecutive sessions, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either print would show the low-blowoff HOLD regime was already wrong and a stress or melt-up phase had taken over

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
